steps.what: Obtain the patient's actual account of symptoms, injury, function, prior treatment and relevant history, clarify ambiguities, and capture the surgeon's factual findings as contemporaneous notes or authorised dictation.

Read the relevant existing clinical record and original reports in the electronic health record {OTHER}, verifying patient identity, chronology, medication and allergy context and conflicts with the actual account.

Prepare case histories in the electronic health record {OTHER}; native note fields reuse verified record details, then a bounded draft may organise the surgeon's actual captured findings into a history while retaining edits and unresolved facts.

loop.purpose: Organise actual captured history findings without inventing clinical facts
loop.input: Permitted surgeon capture and verified record details with provenance
loop.output: Draft history with source references and missing or conflicting facts marked
loop.check: Surgeon compares the full narrative with actual capture and original records in s4, including negation, laterality and chronology
loop.stop: At most two drafts; unsupported or ambiguous statements require manual correction, with manual writing if source capture is unavailable
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields cover fixed facts but not the patient's narrative; no model diagnosis or treatment selection is required

steps.what: Check and correct the completed case history against the patient account, captured findings and original records, verifying meaning, laterality, chronology, uncertainty, identity and exact encounter version.
Commit the exact checked case history to the identified encounter in the electronic health record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Test native history templates and verified record fields in the electronic health record {OTHER} first. A bounded draft can organise actual surgeon-captured findings, with full source-to-meaning review before the separate record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: History-taking, source reconciliation and narrative composition are different kinds of work.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled note structures and bounded drafts can reduce composition without replacing history-taking.
tasks.still_hard: Negation, laterality and uncertain chronology must remain faithful to the patient.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon clarifies the account and determines what the record can honestly say.

ambition.what: No additional clinical service or diagnostic authority is claimed.

tasks.altitude: Less narrative assembly leaves more attention for source conflicts; clinical responsibility remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Trace final statements to actual encounter evidence.

evidence.claim: Source-bounded clinical note drafting can support composition while the clinician verifies the complete history.

assumptions: Boundary: history capture, source reconciliation, narrative preparation and internal record commit; examination, diagnosis and treatment are separate work and earn no saving.

The patient supplies the actual account; the surgeon captures findings in s1, including relevant chronology, side, symptoms and uncertainty. Record owners supply existing dated reports and medication/allergy entries. s1-s2 include actual capture and manual clarification; no free transcript or verified summary is assumed.

If authorised dictation or notes are not available, the surgeon writes manually. Only a permitted clinical drafting environment is used; actual access, device status and national requirements must be checked by the institution.
The ordinary completed-history check in s4 supplies the requested commit gate without additional approval labour. Changed narrative, identity or encounter invalidates it.
Shares and reductions are illustrative E1 estimates, not measured clinical baselines; existing automatic fields and system runtime earn no additional saving.
unknowns: Current clinical note tools and permitted source capture
Actual institutional validation and access requirements
research_questions: Does full source review leave a net reduction in active history composition?

already_counted.description: Actual history-taking and capture, record reconciliation, draft editing, full review and commit remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain note structures and sample-check draft omissions and source fidelity.

approvals.approved_version: Exact case-history contents, patient and encounter checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 less 2 upkeep yields net 8 when existing captured findings support a useful draft. Poor capture or already-efficient composition can yield no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify the actual patient's current clinical record, planned procedure, allergies, medication context and relevant preoperative or postoperative findings in the electronic health record {OTHER}.
Assess the actual patient and discuss the relevant preoperative or postoperative needs, concerns and current condition without replacing clinical examination or patient communication.

Determine the appropriate preoperative and postoperative treatments and procedures, including whether medication, diet or operative-area preparation is indicated, within the surgeon's competence and applicable clinical protocols.

Prepare the selected medication and procedure orders in the electronic prescribing system {OTHER}; native approved order sets reuse appropriate fields while the surgeon enters patient-specific details and resolves surveillance alerts.

Check the completed treatment orders against actual patient findings, indication, allergies, medication surveillance, timing, route or procedure details and intended receiving care team, resolving any inconsistency before release.
Prescribe preoperative and postoperative treatments and procedures by signing the exact checked orders in the electronic prescribing system {OTHER}.
Transmit the exact signed treatment orders to the identified pharmacy or care-team destination using the existing electronic prescribing system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Test existing approved order sets and rule-based medication surveillance in {OTHER}. Reduce only repeated order-field preparation; keep assessment, treatment choice, alert resolution and final order checks with the surgeon, followed by distinct signing and transmission actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standard order fields do not establish that a treatment suits the actual patient.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order sets can reuse appropriate fields without autonomous prescribing.
tasks.still_hard: Patient-specific contraindications and changing clinical needs.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon selects treatment and remains responsible for the prescription.

ambition.what: No broader prescribing authority or new treatment is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Small reductions in order preparation leave the clinical decision and patient interaction unchanged.

reach.learn: Understand alert provenance and resolve discrepancies with the receiving team.

evidence.claim: Native order sets and rule-based surveillance can support order preparation while the authorised clinician decides and signs treatment.

assumptions: Boundary: the surgeon's assessment-to-prescription work; medication administration, operative preparation by other staff and pharmacy work earn no saving here.

Record owners and actual examination supply patient/encounter identity, condition, procedure, medication and allergy context. The surgeon verifies these in s1-s2, selects treatment in s3 and supplies exact patient-specific order fields in s4. Missing facts require retained direct clarification.
Native order sets are tested first. No default medication or dose is accepted solely because it appears in a set; no model selects treatment. Existing surveillance runtime earns no labour saving.

Signing and transmission are shown separately even when adjacent controls in the same interface. The ordinary final-order check in s5 gates each exact action; changed treatment, patient, route, timing or destination invalidates both, without added approval ceremony.
Shares and cuts are illustrative E1 estimates, not measured baselines; actual access and prescribing authority depend on institutional and national rules.
unknowns: Which approved order sets are already used
research_questions: Is there repeated active field entry beyond the existing order-set facilities?

already_counted.description: Patient checks, actual assessment, treatment choice, order exceptions, final review, signing and transmission remain counted.

incremental.description: Review approved order-set fields and alert behaviour after controlled changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient-specific treatment order version checked in s5
Exact checked order version and receiving destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 4.5 less 1 upkeep yields net 3.5 where repeated approved order fields remain manual. Existing efficient order sets yield no additional saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the actual consultation request, patient record, procedure context and current findings with the treating team, establishing the orthopedic surgeon's role and limits.

Provide consultation to other physicians and surgeons by assessing the actual clinical issue, discussing uncertainty, explaining the orthopedic judgement and agreeing the appropriate assistance within the treating team's responsibilities.
outputs: actual consultation conclusions and assistance plan

steps.what: Verify the actual patient, procedure, consent, agreed assistance, team readiness and immediate conditions before each operative assistance action; resolve discrepancies with the responsible operating team.
inputs: actual consultation conclusions and assistance plan

steps.what: Provide surgical assistance to other physicians and surgeons within the exact checked immediate scope, performing the actual physical work and responding to changing operative conditions.
Write the surgeon's actual consultation and assistance contribution in the electronic health record {OTHER}, checking the completed note for patient, findings, role, actions and uncertainty.
inputs: actual consultation conclusions and assistance plan

steps.what: Save the exact checked consultation and assistance note in the identified patient encounter in {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Retain consultation, physical surgical assistance and the surgeon's actual contribution note. Test native record and template facilities in {OTHER}, but no duplicated entry or large composition burden is established in this work to justify a new drafting loop.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on immediate clinical judgement, teamwork and physical assistance.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record tools already support the small required note.
tasks.still_hard: Changing operative conditions and clear responsibility between clinicians.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon provides skilled physical assistance and accountable clinical judgement.

ambition.what: No additional clinical scope is proposed.

tasks.altitude: The surgeon's week and operative responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Maintain clear role boundaries and communicate changes promptly.

evidence.claim: Direct clinical consultation and physical surgical assistance remain human work; a short existing note does not establish an automation return.

assumptions: Boundary: the consulting surgeon's actual contribution, including relevant preparation, physical assistance and own contribution record. The main operator's work and other staff labour are not claimed as savings.

The referring clinician and actual patient record supply identity, clinical question, procedure, findings and requested assistance. The surgeon checks missing or conflicting facts directly in s1-s3; no free prepared summary is assumed.

s3-s4 repeat for the next immediate assistance scope as conditions change. The gate is the existing immediate clinical check, not a software queue or additional approval delay; changed conditions invalidate it. No detailed operative instructions are proposed here.
The separate completed-note check in s5 gates s6; edits or changed patient identity invalidate it without additional self-approval labour.
Shares are illustrative E1 estimates. The actual record write and save are split and retained before reaching zero saving. Zero upkeep is justified because no new system or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Actual contribution-record requirements and current template use
research_questions: Is any real duplicated contribution record present outside this clinical work?

already_counted.description: Clinical preparation, consultation, readiness, actual assistance, note writing and save remain fully counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact immediate patient, procedure and assistance scope checked in s3
Exact contribution note and patient encounter checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual consultation, physical assistance and their short separate contribution note all remain; no repeated operation is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Some case-history and order preparation may become shorter; consultation, surgery and prescribing remain the surgeon's responsibility.
reach: Learn source-fidelity checks and medication-order discrepancy handling.
role.ambitious_version: Use reliable preparation to give more attention to conflicting history and patient-specific treatment needs.
